qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Pan-European elderly care-home portfolio with long triple-net leases; unlevered returns on capital of 3-5% fail the 12% ROIC threshold, and care-home operator solvency fragility limits real rental pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC = 4.2%, REJECT). Pan-European healthcare REIT fails capital efficiency hurdles with unlevered portfolio yields of 5.3-5.5% and ROIC < 5%. Fragile care-home operator economics and state reimbursement caps prevent real pricing power.
qualitative.evidence: Aedifica manages a €6.0B+ healthcare portfolio of ~600 properties across Belgium, Germany, the UK, the Netherlands, and Nordics. While WAULT exceeds 18 years and inflation indexation is contractually embedded, unlevered portfolio net initial yields hover at 5.3-5.5%, leading to historical GAAP ROIC of 3-5% (sub-12% hurdle). Debt-to-assets sits at ~41% and S&P net debt/EBITDA is ~9.0x. Operator margin pressures from nursing wage inflation and fixed state health budgets introduce persistent tenant credit risks.
